thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting Raven customer finetune bring-up. It's a LoRA merge onto redwood/galen-1. They'll need int4 quantization but want parity with float16 for the QA suite.

david: Thanks. Which model variant did they fine-tune against?

maria: base is galen-1-13b-fp16. LoRA merge created adaptor file raven_lora_v1.safetensors.

anya: I'll run a quick compatibility check for tokenizer mapping. If there's any special tokens we need to add i'm on it.

sahil: Can we avoid full eval until we verify KV-cache layout and attention dims? Last time an adapter had a hidden-size mismatch and we got silent degradation.

maria: Good call. Steps I'm planning: 1) tokenizer sanity (anya) 2) structural merge check (david) 3) tiny batch smoke eval with evalpack_raven_quick (lena + qa-bot) 4) int4 quantization trial with fallback to int8 if divergence > 1% (sahil).

lena: Will run evalpack now. Tests: answer-quality top1, token-precision on numeric outputs, latency baseline. Expect <2.5% QA drop on float16 baseline.

qa-bot: running: python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model merged/raven-galen1 --pack evalpack_raven_quick --shots 5 --seed 42

qa-bot: quick results: top1_accuracy: 0.964, numeric_error_rate: 0.021, rouge_l: 0.88, avg_latency_ms: 210

maria: Nice — within target for float16. Next: try int4 quant using quantize_tool v0.9 with per-channel scales. sahil, want to take lead?

sahil: On it. Command I'll run: quantize_tool --input merged/raven-galen1 --backend awq --bits 4 --perchannel --out merged/raven-galen1-int4

deploy-bot: note: dedicated test pool has GPUs allocated (pools/eng-ml-quant), 2 x A10G reserved for 30m

sahil: int4 smoke done. Quick evalpack on int4: top1_accuracy: 0.937 (-2.7% vs fp16), numeric_error_rate: 0.035 (+67%), avg_latency_ms: 185

anya: Tokenizer mapping check: found 3 custom tokens in raven metadata: <raven_cmd>, <amt>, <cust_sep>. I patched tokenizer and ran tokenization parity check. No shift in token ids for core vocab.

david: Structural check: adapter applied cleanly, no hidden-dim mismatch. KV cache shape aligned with galen-1 runtime.

lena: int4 regression on numerics is worrying. Suggest two mitigations: 1) per-layer fallback (keep first N layers in fp16) 2) contrastive prompt calibration for numeric tasks. Which to try first?

sahil: I'll try per-layer fp16 for first 4 transformer layers and re-quantize rest to int4.

qa-bot: re-run: python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model merged/raven-galen1-int4-4fp16 --pack evalpack_raven_quick

qa-bot: quick results: top1_accuracy: 0.955 (-0.9% vs fp16), numeric_error_rate: 0.024 (+14%), avg_latency_ms: 198

maria: That's within our 1% QA tolerance and numeric drop is acceptable to the customer given latency/cost gains.

anya: I pushed tokenizer patch to model metadata and flagged the three tokens in the manifest. Also added a small prompt template to handle <amt> parsing.

maria: Next actions: 1) document quant profile and recommend int4 with first-4-layers-fp16 for Raven (put in onboarding checklist) 2) schedule a customer-facing summary with Raven SEs 3) open a follow-up to run full evalpack and safety scans before prod rollout. Anyone want to own the follow-up?

david: I'll own the full eval + safety scans. ETA EOW.

lena: I'll prepare the cost/latency comparison slide for the SE call.

maria: Great. Thanks team. tagging this thread as resolved for the quickpack stage. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: alloc release scheduled in 5m for pools/eng-ml-quant

sahil: leaving notes in the model card: "Recommended runtime: redwood/galen-1 merged with raven_lora_v1; quantization: int4 with first-4-layers-fp16 fallback; eval pack results and numeric caveats."

maria: Perfect. Closing thread.
